title: Senior Generative AI / RAG Engineer
description: We are seeking a Senior AI Engineer to spearhead our next-generation RAG search infrastructure. You will design, build, and deploy high-speed vector retrieval pipelines, fine-tune Small Language Models (SLMs), and implement production-grade LLM applications using PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain, and FastAPI.

title: Full Stack AI Engineer
description: Looking for a versatile Full Stack Developer who enjoys pairing modern web interfaces (React/TypeScript/HTML/CSS) with intelligent Python AI backends. You will build user-facing generative AI tools, integrate LangChain and HuggingFace pipelines, and ship scalable RESTful APIs.

title: Cloud & MLOps Infrastructure Engineer
description: Join our platform team to architect robust Kubernetes infrastructure, automate CI/CD deployments for AI workloads, manage multi-region AWS environments, and ensure high availability for PyTorch inference clusters using Terraform and Prometheus.
